headline: Nigeria Domestic Refineries Supply 61% of Country's Petrol in 13-Month Period
summary: Domestic refineries supplied 12.01 billion litres, or 61.2%, of the 19.68 billion litres of petrol distributed in Nigeria between September 2025 and September 2026, while fuel imports fell to 7.67 billion litres.
why: Nigeria's domestic fuel refining capacity reduces reliance on expensive imported petroleum, easing foreign currency pressures on the Central Bank of Nigeria's reserves.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Supplying over 60% of domestic fuel needs domestically decreases foreign exchange outflows required for refined product imports.
